item.title: 13. Day 11 - to Twyfelfontein
item.description: Heading back down (197kms), via Palmwag (refuel) to the Twyfelfontein area (remember the elevated pub - about 7kms further than camp).

item.title: 14. Day 12 - Desolation valley
item.description: And now for something completely barren … The longest stretch of this expedition (233kms).

item.title: 4. Day 2 - to Brandberg
item.description: Back up to the Umaruru river, Uis & White Lady We head back up to the Umaruru river on a different route.

item.title: 6. Day 4 - to Khowarib
item.description: 126kms of really diverse and exciting riding - everything from hilly, rocky to hardpack, sandy and even fesh-fesh.

item.title: 10. Day 8 - to Marble Camp
item.description: A relative short distance (63kms) but an action packed day with striking scenery over the Marienfluss grasslands and rugged mountains that make it a bucket-list experience for serious adventurers.

item.title: 12. Day 10 - to Ongongo
item.description: A longer day in the saddle (192kms), typically described as a slow, technical 4×4 day rather than a “road drive”.

item.title: 29. River crossing mitigation
item.description: Because we’ll be travelling on two wheels with support vehicles, crossing and travelling in several rivers, having up-to-date information on river levels and flow / flood risk is very important.

item.title: 3. Day 1 - to Spitzkoppe
item.description: Up the Umaruru river We will confirm the conditions of the riverbeds prior to doing this and other sections of the route, but assuming conditions are good, we’ll travel about 80kms inside the Umaruru riverbed, hang right and head down to Spitzkoppe.
